LightningComponentBundle.description: Toast notification component with platform event and page load support

property.name: toastMessage
property.label: Toast Message
property.description: Override message for all toasts. Use {recordId} for record ID

property.name: toastVariant
property.label: Toast Variant
property.description: Override variant: success, error, warning, info (optional)

property.name: toastKeys
property.label: Toast Keys (comma separated)
property.description: Filter platform event toasts by key values (optional)

property.name: runInSystemMode
property.label: Run in System Mode
property.description: For platform events: show toasts to all users

property.name: usePlatformEvents
property.label: Use Platform Events
property.description: Enable platform event listening (uncheck for page load only)

property.name: showOnPageLoad
property.label: Show Toast on Page Load
property.description: Show toast when page loads (works without platform events)

property.name: showDelay
property.label: Page Load Delay (ms)
property.description: Delay before showing page load toast

property.name: showOnlyOnce
property.label: Show Only Once Per Session
property.description: Page load toast shows only once per browser session
